georef.method: Matterport showcase geocoordinates (east,north = R(theta) p + t), verified by eye on Vexcel; ~2-3 m offset
georef.convention: east,north = R_ccw(rotation_deg) @ [x,y]; compass heading = map heading - rotation_deg
